touches.subject: A processing review for {{companyName}}
touches.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I’m reaching out from Liberty Bancard about payment processing at {{companyName}}. We can review your patient-payment processing statement and explain its fees.

The review separates network costs, processor markup and fixed fees. There’s no obligation to switch, and we’ll tell you if your current pricing is already competitive.

Would you be interested in a free statement review? A quick reply is all I need to get started.

touches.subject: A clearer breakdown of your processing fees
touches.body:
Hello,

Following up on my note about patient-payment processing at {{companyName}}. A statement review can separate network costs, processor markup and fixed fees using the same transaction volume.

If a breakdown would be useful, you can request a review at https://libertybancard.com/upload-statement. Please use the secure form rather than emailing financial documents.

touches.subject: Should I close the loop?
touches.body:
Hello,

This is my final follow-up about reviewing patient-payment processing at {{companyName}}. If a fee breakdown would help later, you can request a review at https://libertybancard.com/upload-statement.

No need to reply if the timing is not right.
